title: The “Popol Vuh” or Book of the Holy Assembly
notes: The Word, vols. 2–4, October 1905–November 1906; 14 installments, including two introductory installments.

The final installment prints THE END at vol. 4 p. 124, after Part IV chapter XI; Brasseur Part IV chapter XII (final genealogies) is absent. Complete located serial run does NOT mean complete Popol Vuh translation.
Checked volume indexes and article boundaries against the IAPSOP facsimiles; those PDFs are not redistributed. Acquired independent Internet Archive microfilm OCR and provided its facsimile recipes.
Vols. 4 and 5 OCR/index search found no later continuation through September 1907; negative OCR evidence is not exhaustive proof.
Guthrie acknowledges borrowing some English terms from James Pryse. Translation relationship to Brasseur should be tested passage by passage.
text_quality: Uncorrected Internet Archive OCR of whole issues, including unrelated articles; use installment page ranges to isolate Guthrie.
